cards.subject: a calm biophilic bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a low birch toddler daybed and a round oak wall shelf
cards.scene: A bright room with a pale ash floor and warm greige walls. An oval wool rug with wavy edges holds wax crayons in a wooden cup, an open drawing book and a small wooden car. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low natural birch toddler daybed, 140 by 70 cm, with checkered and striped bolster pillows, a small potted fern on the floor beside it and a round oak shelf with two picture books. Crisp morning daylight from a window on the LEFT falls in clear patches on the floor. A toddler boy of about two and a half in a navy knit sweater and light grey trousers sits on the rug in the middle of the floor with his back to the camera, holding wax crayons in a wooden cup with an open drawing book on the rug, his face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural. Palette: pale birch, soft sage, oat, bouclé cream and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the biplanes and the striped hot-air balloons: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale.

cards.subject: a warm boho nursery for a baby under 2, with a circular quilted play mat and a low birch book ledge
cards.scene: A soft nursery with a terracotta tile floor and sand-coloured walls. A rust-striped cotton dhurrie lies on the tiles, with two cloth baby books and a wooden teething ring on the quilted mat. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a circular quilted organic cotton mat with wooden sensory blocks, a low birch book ledge 35 cm high with cloth books, and a small round ceramic vase with dried grasses. Soft afternoon light from a window on the RIGHT lies in warm patches on the tiles. A sheer cream linen curtain hangs at the extreme left edge of the frame, close to the camera and slightly out of focus, as a foreground layer. Palette: terracotta, warm brown, muted green, cream and birch.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the biplanes and the striped hot-air balloons: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale. Nothing stands in front of the mural.

clips.motion: The camera does not move at all: it is a fixed, static shot. A toddler boy of about two and a half in a navy knit sweater and light grey trousers sits on the rug with his back to the camera, his head bowed toward the open drawing book on the rug in front of him. Calmly and at a natural pace he draws on the page with a crayon in his right hand, making small unhurried strokes, while his left hand rests on the page. Only his right hand and forearm move; he stays seated and his head stays bowed. Only the back of his head, his hair and his clothes are seen.
clips.items: daybed, bolster pillows, round shelf, potted fern, oval rug, crayon cup, drawing book, wooden car, picture frame and architecture

clips.motion: The camera advances straight forward into the room at a clearly visible calm walking pace, about one metre in five seconds, as if a person is entering, with no sideways drift, no tilt and no rotation. The sheer cream curtain at the extreme left edge of the frame leaves the frame as the camera advances past it, and the nearer objects shift more than the farther ones, giving a natural depth parallax. Fine dust drifts slowly through the sunbeam and the warm sunlight patches on the floor shift gently.
clips.items: quilted mat, sensory blocks, book ledge, dhurrie rug, cloth books, teething ring, ceramic vase, picture frame and architecture
